scripts.demo:typecheck: wrangler types -c demo-shop/wrangler.jsonc demo-shop/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-env=false && tsc --noEmit -p demo-shop
scripts.demo:setup: wrangler d1 migrations apply demo-shop-db --remote -c demo-shop/wrangler.jsonc && node demo-shop/scripts/seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute demo-shop-db --remote -c demo-shop/wrangler.jsonc --file demo-shop/seed.sql
scripts.demo:break-search: wrangler deploy -c demo-shop/wrangler.jsonc --var FEATURE_FULLTEXT_SEARCH:on --message "Enable full-text product search"
scripts.demo:break-errors: wrangler deploy -c demo-shop/wrangler.jsonc --var FAULT_ERROR_RATE:0.2 --message "Switch inventory client to backend pool v2"
scripts.demo:fix: wrangler deploy -c demo-shop/wrangler.jsonc --message "Roll back to baseline"
